exceptions.rationale: Re-reviewed 2026-10-01: no patched image-size release is currently available. The locked finding remains confined to Expo/Metro dependency inspection used to build the mobile app, and Woof does not expose image-size as an application runtime parser for attacker-supplied ICNS/JXL/HEIF data. Re-evaluate on Expo/Metro or image-size release changes, and remove this exception as soon as an installable upstream fix exists.
